name: How long does a typical walk-in shower installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical walk-in shower installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a walk-in shower installation can vary based on the complexity of the project, including existing plumbing modifications, waterproofing requirements, and the materials chosen. A standard installation, replacing an existing tub or shower, typically takes 3 to 5 days. More extensive remodels involving layout changes or custom features might extend to 1-2 weeks. We provide a detailed timeline after assessing your specific bathroom and project scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard walk-in shower installation usually takes 3 to 5 days, but can extend to 1-2 weeks for more complex remodels.
